gherkin.scenario: Add a new department with allowance
given: I am logged in as an administrator
when: I click Settings in the header
I click the Add new department button
I fill in the department name field with "test"
then: I should see the success message "Changes to departments were saved"
The department "test" should be in the list with an allowance of 10

gherkin_acceptance_criteria: I should see the success message "Changes to departments were saved"
The department "test" should be in the list with an allowance of 10
